pageDescription: Request your university degree at the National University of Concepción through the official form.
heading: University Degree Request
description: Start the process of obtaining your university diploma online through the official form of the National University of Concepción.
ctaNote: This form opens in Google Forms in a new tab.

step01.title: Complete the form
step01.description: Enter your personal information and details about your program.

step02.title: Attach documentation
step02.description: National ID, graduation certificate and other documents required by your school.

step03.title: Track your request
step03.description: You will receive notifications about the status of your request via your registered email.

step04.title: Degree pickup
step04.description: Once approved, we will notify you of the date and place for collecting your university diploma.
